messages:
lee (DevEx): Quick call — putting up a small PR for run history: condensed callstack card with metrics badge. Thoughts on contrast and copy?
maya (Design): Saw the mock, looks promising. The badge contrast feels light on 12px text. Can we use token `--surface-contrast-2`? :eyes: 
sam (PM): Agree with better contrast. Also keep metric labels short: `gen ms` vs `gen latency`?
alex (Eng): Implementation note: using existing Badge component, only supports 12/14px. Increasing weight hurts density but we can switch to 14px for badges in compact mode.
maya (Design): prefer 12px bold over 14 normal. It keeps density. Maybe change color from `#6B7280` -> `#4B5563` (example).
lee (DevEx): Can you paste a quick code snippet for the colors? I'll try in the component playground.
maya (Design): Sure:
```
.compact-badge {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #4B5563; /* surface-contrast-1 */
  background: rgba(75,85,99,0.06);
}
```
alex (Eng): That helps. Concern: background alpha causes a11y issues on some backgrounds. a11y-bot: contrast ratio for text on `rgba(75,85,99,0.06)` over white is 7.5:1? (bot)
lee (DevEx): @a11y-bot can you run a quick check against light/dark themes?
a11y-bot: Running... result: text color `#4B5563` on `rgba(75,85,99,0.06)` fails WCAG AA for 12px normal. Passes for 12px bold. Also fails on dark theme if background is too transparent.
sam (PM): So go with 12px bold, but add a darker fallback for dark theme. Also update tooltip copy to "Gen latency" for clarity (short but unambiguous).
maya (Design): Tooltip change ok. Also suggest adding `aria-label` on badge: `aria-label="Generation latency: 123 ms"` for screen readers.
alex (Eng): I'll open a small PR: set font-weight 600, add dark fallback token `--surface-contrast-2`, and aria-label.
lee (DevEx): Nice. One more UX nit: when you expand a call in run history, can we pin the metrics badge to the top-right so it doesn't scroll off?
maya (Design): Yes — pin visually, but keep it in DOM order for keyboard nav.
alex (Eng): Implementation plan: position: sticky on the card header. Works in the layout.
sam (PM): timeline? We can aim for tomorrow alpha in staging.
lee (DevEx): Cool. @alex please assign me the PR and drop the preview link here :thumbsup: 
alex (Eng): Will do — PR: #7842. Preview link: https://staging.playground.redwood/run/preview/7842
maya (Design): Quick visual note after seeing preview: bump spacing 4px between badge and title.
lee (DevEx): Noted. Thank you all. Closing loop after PR merges.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch/pr-7842 on staging — ETA ~8m :rocket:
